stock.description: Vanke Overseas Investment Holding Company Limited functions as an investment holding firm, primarily dedicated to real estate ventures. Its activities encompass the acquisition, development, financing, leasing, and management of properties in key markets including Hong Kong, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Additionally, the company delivers a suite of services such as property redevelopment, asset management, administrative support, and investment advisory. Originally named Vanke Property (Overseas) Limited, it rebranded to its current title in December 2019. Founded in 1996, the organization maintains its headquarters in Central, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of Wkland Investments Company Limited.
